'''Trindello''' was a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trindello/Legends|Trindello]] orbited a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that in turn orbited the [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="TEA" />
